dog.description_text: This gorgeous girl is Taffy! She's incredibly smart, friendly, and outgoing. She would do great with someone who is familiar with husky-type dogs and is willing to embrace her fun loving husky spirit. Taffy loves her people friends and enjoys going on walks, hiking, and other outside activities. Taffy would do best in a home with no other fur babies. And in a home with older children so she has all the love and attention. This cutie resides at our Westhampton location. We invite you to visit, no appointment needed! Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
dog.name: Taffy
